sentences.text: On advance notice, Mr. Ajit Kumar Mohanty, Advocate has appeared for the opposite party No.2.
During the investigation of the case, the petitioner has moved an application for anticipatory bail before this Court.
This Court vide its order dated 06.11.2020 in ABLAPL No.12815 of 2021 had rejected the same.
Subsequent thereto, the charge sheet has been filed in the present case on 30.11.2021 for the alleged commission of the offences punishable under Sections 366/376(2)(n) of the IPC.
The petitioner has been shown as absconder.
Hence, vide order dated 07.12.2021, order of N.B.W. has been issued against the petitioner.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, the petitioner would surrender/appear before the trial Court on or before 30.03.2025 and resort to the remedy available to him under law.
